attribute_fields.COMMENTS: North Carolina state income tax calculation. Implements flat 4.25% tax rate with standard deductions per NC tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "North Carolina Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.nc_subtractions xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_postfix: result.nc_standard_deduction_single /result.nc_total_deduction xdef "NC standard deduction (Single): $" result.nc_total_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Married Filing Jointly: Apply standard deduction $25,500
action_details.action_postfix: result.nc_standard_deduction_joint /result.nc_total_deduction xdef "NC standard deduction (MFJ): $" result.nc_total_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Head of Household: Apply standard deduction $22,500
action_details.action_postfix: result.nc_standard_deduction_hoh /result.nc_total_deduction xdef "NC standard deduction (HOH): $" result.nc_total_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Other statuses: Apply single standard deduction $12,750
action_details.action_postfix: result.nc_standard_deduction_single /result.nc_total_deduction xdef "NC standard deduction (Other): $" result.nc_total_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NC AGI (Federal AGI minus subtractions)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.nc_subtractions sub 0 max /result.nc_agi xdef
"NC AGI (after subtractions): $" result.nc_agi cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NC taxable income (NC AGI - standard deduction, minimum 0)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.nc_agi result.nc_total_deduction sub 0 max /result.nc_taxable_income xdef
"NC taxable income: $" result.nc_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nc_taxable_income result.nc_tax_rate mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"North Carolina tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: North Carolina military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for 20+ years of service or medical retirement (Group B). Changed from partial to full exemption in 2021. MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NC Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.nc_military_retirement_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from NC taxable income. Requirement: 20+ years of service or medical retirement (changed from partial to full in 2021).
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.nc_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.nc_subtractions result.nc_military_retirement_exclusion add /result.nc_subtractions xdef
"NC Military Retirement Exclusion (Full for 20+ yrs or medical): $" result.nc_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.nc_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "NC Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
